_about: FFIEC v1 negative test-vector N023. Pointer fixture: describes the tampering recipe applied to the base 001-single-event-empty-prev fixture. A reference runner reads `base_input`, applies the listed `header_overrides`, and feeds the tampered chain to the verifier under test.

tamper.everything_else: untouched (hkdf_inputs_digest valid, genesis_hash all-zero, entry.format_version = v1, payload_hash valid, seal valid)
tamper._note: The byte-level distinction is two ASCII bytes: `0x76 0x31` (lowercase v1, canonical) vs `0x56 0x31` (uppercase V1, the tampered variant). Every other byte in the chain file is unchanged. A verifier that case-folds the field before comparing produces a false-pass; a verifier that compares bytes-on-the-wire byte-for-byte refuses at step 1.
